messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

The supported signal-integrity capabilities for wireless communication applications are high-speed digital/PCB validation capabilities: transmission-channel validation, interface testing, RefClk/PLL jitter measurement, PDN testing, ADC/DAC frontend testing, and PCB/PCBA SI flow covering insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance [7].
| Capability | What it covers | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Transmission-channel validation | Tx/Rx path, channel, Tx package, PCBs, connectors, Rx package, and equalization/DSP/DAC/ADC context for high-speed electrical interfaces [2] | [2] |
| Interface test | Scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices for validating high-speed electrical interfaces [2] | [2] |
| RefClk and PLL jitter performance | Phase-noise analyzers and signal generators for reference-clock and PLL jitter performance validation [2] | [2] |
| Power Distribution Network / power integrity | PDN testing with scopes and network analyzers [2] | [2] |
| ADC/DAC frontend performance | Spectrum analyzers and signal generators for ADC/DAC frontend performance testing [2] | [2] |
| PCB/PCBA SI flow | Insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [2] | [2] |
| PCB material/stackup and SI modeling | Impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, and signal-integrity modeling/testing [33] | [33] |
| Wireless infrastructure digital-design test tools | High-speed digital and power designs in mobile network infrastructure need fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools including VNA, probes, phase-noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [46] | [46] |
| Higher-frequency / mmWave network-analysis capability | Wireless infrastructure sources list network-analysis products up to 67 GHz, 110 GHz, and banded mmWave converters up to 1.1 THz in the “More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies” context [49] | [49] |
| OTA/MIMO/beamforming-related measurement capability | Active antennas and Massive MIMO make measured systems more complex, high frequencies make conducted testing impractical, and OTA testing becomes necessary at higher frequencies / Massive MIMO [47] | [47] |
【推論】For wireless communication, the most important SI capability set is therefore a combined workflow: high-speed PCB/channel SI, clock-jitter validation, PDN/power integrity, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and VNA/probing/oscilloscope/signal-source based debug, because the wireless-infrastructure source explicitly connects high-speed digital and power designs to those T&M tools, while the SI/PI source details the corresponding SI validation blocks [46][7].

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Reference plane 與 vias
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signal trace 從 origination 到 termination 必須全程維持相同 GND reference。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100 › 重點摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD 與 TDD device testing。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 配置包含 OBT lite、OBT、OBT plus、OBT FR1 specialist、OBT FR2 specialist，主要差異在 [[R&S CMX-B200A]] accelerator unit、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit、[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的數量。
- [[NR FR1]] 與 [[LTE]] 測試使用 integrated RF units；[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的 frequency range 為 **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- [[NR FR2]] 測試可搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] remote radio head；remote radio head 在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。
- 適用的 radiated chamber test environments 包含 [[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 vector signal analysis 與 ARB generator，可做 FR2 transmitters / receivers RF parametric testing；5G NR receiver tests 可在 3GPP fading propagation conditions 下使用 internal baseband fading emulation。
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘，符合指定 environmental conditions，遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Impedance 與 length matching
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[PCIe specification]] 要求 differential impedance 為 70 到 100 Ω。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Add-In-Cards 為了與不同 root complexes 與 end points 互通，需要 85 Ω differential impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 85 Ω differential impedance 要求不適用於 vias、AC coupling capacitor pads、connectors、cables，但仍需注意最小化 impedance discontinuity。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 clock target impedance 為 100 Ω；maximum allowed random jitter RMS 為 200 fs，對滿足 PCIe Gen5 link EQ validation test requirements 很重要。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說不需要在不同 lanes 或 pairs 之間做 trace length matching；每個 differential pair 內嵌 clock，因此允許不同 differential trace length。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 intra-pair trace positive lead 與 negative lead 長度需控制在 5 mils 以內，以降低 common-mode noise。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Crosstalk mitigation
[[snla426]]（June 2023）指出 crosstalk mitigation 可透過降低 differential signal insertion loss（SDD21）或改善 crosstalk 達成，方法包括：

- 最大化 pair-to-pair spacing。
- [[ground stitching]]。

| Interface test | Scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices for validating high-speed electrical interfaces [2] | [2] |

| Power Distribution Network / power integrity | PDN testing with scopes and network analyzers [2] | [2] |
| ADC/DAC frontend performance | Spectrum analyzers and signal generators for ADC/DAC frontend performance testing [2] | [2] |
| PCB/PCBA SI flow | Insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [2] | [2] |
| PCB material/stackup and SI modeling | Impedance/TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, eye diagram, and signal-integrity modeling/testing [33] | [33] |
| Wireless infrastructure digital-design test tools | High-speed digital and power designs in mobile network infrastructure need fast, reliable, accurate T&M tools including VNA, probes, phase-noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [46] | [46] |

- Slide 9 以表格整理 [[High speed SerDes eco-chain]]，分成上游基礎材料與核心元件、中游模組整合與生產製造、下游終端應用與市場部署三層。
- Slide 11 題為 **Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces**，把高速電性介面驗證拆成 transmission channel、measurement path to DUT / test board development、[[Power Distribution Network]]、ADC / DAC frontend performance、RefClk and PLL jitter performance、interface test 等區塊，並列出 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices、phase noise analyzers、signal generators、network analyzers、spectrum analyzers 等儀器類型。
- Slide 17 題為 **HDI vs Package substrate**，以 [[CoWoS]]、[[Package Substrate]]、[[ABF]]、L/S 與 pitch 等字樣比較，但轉檔文字排列不完整，數值對應關係未能可靠確認。
- Slide 20 題為 **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA**，列出 [[IL]] / [[Xtalk]] / [[Eye diagram]]、[[TDR Impedance]]、[[Stackup Planner]]、[[TL Calculator]]。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Spectrum、mmWave 與 early 6G research
- Slide 10 以 `More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies` 連到 transition to 6G 的 RF performance demand。
- Signal generation 產品列名包括 [[R&S SMA100B]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMW200A]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMB100A]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S SMM100A]] up to 44 GHz、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 3/6 GHz，以及 [[R&S SFI]]、[[FE110ST]]、[[FE170ST]]、[[FC330ST]]、[[FC500ST]] 等 frequency converter / front end。
- Spectrum analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S FSW]] up to 90 GHz、[[R&S FSVA3050]] up to 50/54 GHz、[[R&S FPS]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S PVT360A]] / [[R&S CMP200]]、[[FE44S]]、[[FE50DTR]]、[[FC330SR]] 等。
- Network analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S ZNA]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] up to 110 GHz、[[R&S ZNB]]、[[R&S ZVA]] 10 MHz–110 GHz，以及 banded mmW converters up to 1.1 THz。
- Slide 13 early 6G research 提到 up-to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth、up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth、generic OFDM analysis、4096QAM / multi-modulation 與 flat signals over entire frequency range。
